description: An elderly bearded man in a white head wrap and a dark fur-collared coat leans over a brick furnace, pouring a glowing liquid from a long-necked glass retort onto a bed of hot coals that smoke and glow orange. A round glass flask holding golden liquid sits on the wooden table below, beside open old books, loose papers, a brass balance scale, a clay jug and a pair of leather bellows or tongs. The background is dark and warm, in a painterly oil style; the papers carry marks but no legible letters or numbers, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
